qualifier: HSF1 heat shock response and stress granule dynamics
name: HSF1 heat shock response and stress granule dynamics
rationale: All members concern acute cellular stress responses (heat, arsenite, PKR); the combination of HSF1 activation/attenuation with stress granule and PML body regulation separates it from the protein-folding/UPRmt and proteolysis/mRNA-decay neighbours.

core: tRNA and rRNA modification and processing
name: tRNA and rRNA modification with mitochondrial ribosome biogenesis
rationale: Members are RNA methylation/pseudouridylation and processing of tRNA, rRNA and mitochondrial transcripts plus mitoribosome assembly, distinguishing it from neighbours centred on tRNA aminoacylation, translational fidelity or mitochondrial transcription/translation.

name: Ovarian follicle maturation, ovulation and luteinization
rationale: All members cover female gonad follicle growth through ovulation and luteinization, unlike neighbours focused on oocyte meiosis, testis development, progesterone/luteolysis or gonadotropin secretion.

core: Negative regulation of cell-matrix adhesion and protrusion
name: Receptor tyrosine phosphatase restraint of cell-matrix adhesion and protrusion
rationale: Members mostly restrain integrin/focal adhesion signaling, Rho/Rac-driven lamellipodia and actin bundles; receptor tyrosine phosphatase signaling, homophilic adhesion and invadopodia are what neighbours (migration, spreading, keratinocyte/EGF) lack.

qualifier: FGFR1, FGFR3 and FGFR4 via FRS2 and SHC
name: FGFR1, FGFR3 and FGFR4 FRS2/SHC-mediated MAPK signaling
rationale: All members are FGF receptor activation and FRS/SHC cascades to MAPK for FGFR1/3/4 (including FGFR3 isoforms and betaKlotho-FGFR4), unlike neighbours dominated by FGFR2, PI3K/PLCgamma cascades or negative feedback.

qualifier: thiamine and coenzyme A cofactor supply
name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase with thiamine and coenzyme A cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover PDH-mediated pyruvate decarboxylation and the thiamine diphosphate and pantothenate/CoA cofactors it needs, distinguishing it from riboflavin, NAD, lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase and TCA neighbours.

core: Dendritic cell and monocyte surface signatures
name: Dendritic cell and monocyte surface signatures with CD1 lipid presentation
rationale: Members are DC/monocyte surface and enrichment modules plus CD1-mediated lipid antigen presentation, separating it from neutrophil/innate defence, MHC class II peptide presentation, and lymphocyte surface neighbours.

name: GABA shunt and lipoate-dependent glycine and lysine catabolism
rationale: Members span protein lipoylation, glycine cleavage, lysine catabolism and succinyl-CoA formation together with GABA synthesis and degradation, the GABA arm being absent from all neighbours.

qualifier: phosphatidic acid to diacyl- and triacylglycerol
name: Acylglycerol synthesis from phosphatidic acid to triacylglycerol
rationale: All members describe the phosphatidic acid, mono-, di- and triacylglycerol biosynthetic route, distinct from neighbours on glycerol/fructose metabolism or lipid droplet and adipocyte storage.

name: tRNA aminoacylation, anticodon modification and stop-codon recoding
rationale: Members cover cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging, wobble/t6A anticodon modification and decoding fidelity, with selenocysteine synthesis and translational readthrough distinguishing it from tRNA methylation/processing and protein-modification neighbours.

qualifier: nuclear pore complex and mRNA/protein export-import
name: Nuclear pore complex and nucleocytoplasmic RNA and protein transport
rationale: Members are NPC structure/assembly and transport of mRNA, ribosomal subunits, inositol phosphates and NLS proteins through it, separating it from nuclear envelope breakdown/SUMO, RNA processing and lncRNA neighbours.

qualifier: leucine and isoleucine, with organic acidemias
name: Leucine and isoleucine catabolism and organic acidemias
rationale: Members describe leucine and isoleucine breakdown and its inborn errors (isovaleric acidemia, 3-MCC, beta-ketothiolase), unlike neighbours focused on valine catabolism or biotin metabolism.

qualifier: BAF complex assembly and replication-coupled nucleosome organization
name: BAF remodeler assembly and replication-coupled nucleosome organization
rationale: Members are SWI/SNF BAF variants and CHD1/2 remodelers acting on nucleosome assembly/disassembly, with replication-dependent chromatin assembly and repair regulation that the NuRD/CHD7, stem-cell and acetylation neighbours lack.

name: Glutamate, glutamine, aspartate and asparagine nitrogen metabolism
rationale: All members concern glutamate/glutamine and aspartate/asparagine interconversion for nitrogen use, distinct from TCA/alanine, dicarboxylate transport, proline/glycine and conjugation neighbours.

name: TLR7 and TLR8 signaling to IRF5
rationale: All three members are TLR7/8 signaling, including SLC15A4-TASL-dependent IRF5 activation, unlike neighbours centred on TLR9/IRF7, RIG-I/MDA5 or type I interferon responses.

name: IL-17/Th17 and IL-33, IL-36, IL-38 cytokine signaling
rationale: Members cover IL-17 production/signaling and Th17 commitment plus IL-1-family IL-33/IL-36/IL-38 signaling, separating it from IL-18/IL-1 processing, IL-12/23/10 and Dectin neighbours.

name: Exploratory, grooming and psychomotor behavior with amygdala development
rationale: Members are exploratory locomotion, swimming, grooming and psychomotor behaviours with amygdala development, unlike neighbours on adult locomotion/cerebellum, sensorimotor gating/synapses or social behaviour.

qualifier: domain mutants and KIT regulation, not drug resistance
name: Constitutive signaling by KIT domain mutants and its regulation
rationale: All members are KIT receptor signaling by extracellular, juxtamembrane and kinase-domain mutants and its regulation, whereas neighbours concern FLT3/PDGFRA signaling or TKI-resistant KIT/PDGFR mutants.

name: Tubulin polyglutamylation cycle and microtubule severing
rationale: Members are tubulin glutamylation/deglutamylation and the severing/depolymerization it controls, distinct from centrosome, kinesin transport, axoneme assembly and chaperonin tubulin-folding neighbours.

qualifier: transport, purine triphosphate catabolism and analog drugs
name: Nucleoside transport and purine nucleotide catabolism, including analog drugs
rationale: Members cover nucleoside/purine base transporters, NUDT and triphosphate catabolism and nucleoside-analog/thiopurine drug handling, unlike general xenobiotic efflux, nucleotide interconversion or DNA-protection neighbours.

name: Carnitine-dependent fatty acid beta-oxidation and ketone body metabolism
rationale: Members are the stepwise mitochondrial beta-oxidation spiral, carnitine transport/shuttle and ketogenesis/ketolysis, which separates it from fatty acid transport, branched-chain/2-oxoacid catabolism and malonyl-CoA neighbours.

name: RNA surveillance decay and ribosome-associated quality control
rationale: Members span nuclear exosome RNA decay, NMD, no-go/non-stop decay, stalled ribosome rescue and degron-pathway protein disposal, unlike neighbours centred on RNA production/splicing, translation initiation or telomerase/snoRNA biogenesis.

core: Amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Mitochondrial glycine and glutamine conjugation of aromatic acids
rationale: Members are glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate plus the mitochondrial metabolic terms that carry the same enzymes, distinct from CYP drug ADME and broad amino acid metabolism neighbours.

name: Aldosterone synthesis and renal sodium control of blood pressure
rationale: Members combine aldosterone/mineralocorticoid production and response with renal sodium transport, filtration and blood pressure regulation, separating it from vasopressin/angiotensin, potassium transport and glucocorticoid neighbours.

name: Coagulation cascade to fibrin with platelet activation and antifibrinolysis
rationale: Members cover coagulation initiation, amplification and fibrin formation with platelet degranulation and inhibition of plasminogen activation, unlike neighbours on clot dissolution, VWF defects or contact/intrinsic factor defects.
